words.enDefinition: asks how or where to submit material supplementary to a report
acceptedEnVariants: how should I send the appendices

examples.en: How should I send the appendices for the project if they include several large tables?
examples.zh: 如果项目的附录有几张大表，「附录要怎么交」？

examples.en: How should I send the appendices? The course page only has room for the main file.
examples.zh: 「附录要怎么交」？课程页面只能放主文件。

collocations: how should I send the appendices for the report
ask how I should send the appendices
how should I send the appendices separately

words.expression: could we go through the rubric together
words.lemma: could we go through the rubric together
words.zhGloss: 我们能一起看评分标准吗
words.enDefinition: asks to review how the work will be assessed with someone
acceptedZhAnswers: 我们能一起看评分标准吗
acceptedEnVariants: could we go through the rubric together

examples.en: Could we go through the rubric together before I start writing the first draft of my report?
examples.zh: 开始写报告初稿之前，「我们能一起看评分标准吗」？

examples.en: Could we go through the rubric together? I didn't understand the difference between the last two criteria.
examples.zh: 「我们能一起看评分标准吗」？最后两项标准的区别我没弄明白。

collocations: could we go through the rubric together during office hours
ask if we could go through the rubric together
could we go through the rubric together before marking

words.expression: could you respond in the document
words.lemma: could you respond in the document
words.zhGloss: 能在文档里直接回复吗
words.enDefinition: asks the recipient to answer within the document itself
acceptedZhAnswers: 能在文档里直接回复吗
acceptedEnVariants: could you respond in the document

examples.en: Could you respond in the document where I've highlighted two paragraphs that still need work?
examples.zh: 我标出了还要改的两段，「能在文档里直接回复吗」？

examples.en: Could you respond in the document? That way everyone can see which section each comment concerns.
examples.zh: 「能在文档里直接回复吗」？这样大家就能看出每条意见针对哪一部分。

collocations: could you respond in the document beside my notes
could you respond in the document if possible
ask if you could respond in the document

words.enDefinition: to place answers beside the corresponding points in the original message

examples.en: My lecturer chose to reply inline so each answer had some context.
examples.zh: 老师选择「在原文相应位置回复」，让每个答复都有上下文。

examples.en: You can reply inline to the numbered questions in my email.
examples.zh: 你可以对邮件里编号的问题「在原文相应位置回复」。

collocations: choose to reply inline
prefer to reply inline
